context: M21 o1. Corwin lobby table. Bernard with a stopwatch and a floor plan he drew from memory.

lines.speaker: char.bernard_ostrow
lines.text: Mr. Lisle dines at seven-fifteen. He returns for his briefcase at nine-forty. Always.

lines.speaker: char.bernard_ostrow
lines.text: That gives us two hours and twenty-five minutes. Comma. Then disaster. Period.

lines.speaker: char.teddy_arce
lines.text: And if he doesn't go to dinner?

lines.speaker: char.bernard_ostrow
lines.text: Then someone must take him to dinner. Someone he can't refuse.
